Topics · Meaning and purpose

What is the Straight Path, actually?

The Quran defines it: worship of God alone, the way every messenger was commanded, lived in good deeds.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

Quran · Ya-Sin 36:61

﴿ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Guide us to the straight path -

Quran · Al-Fatihah 1:6

Translation

He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

Original · Hebrew

וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

the Psalms · 107:7

World English Bible

Many ask for a straight path without asking what it is. If it had no definition, anyone could claim it. The verse defines it in two short phrases: worship Me; this is a straight path. So the path is no place, group or label. It is a direction: toward God alone. The second verse is a prayer in which a person asks God directly for that direction.

A question for you

How did you picture the Straight Path until now?

If you sayA bridge in the next life.
ThenThat picture is well known from reports. The verses here speak of a road walked now.
If you sayMy religion or my community.
ThenThat is a natural way to see it. The verse defines the path by an act, worship of God alone.
If you sayI had not thought about it.
ThenHere you are beginning. The next part asks who walked it before you.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قُلْ إِنَّنِى هَدَىٰنِى رَبِّىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ١٦١ قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ١٦٢ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ١٦٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Indeed, my Lord has guided me to a straight path - a correct religion - the way of Abraham, inclining toward truth. And he was not among those who associated others with Allāh." Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds. No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."[361]

Translator's notes

[361] i.e., those who submit to the will of Allāh.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:161-163

Translation

Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

Original · Hebrew

גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵחֲטֹ֣א לַֽיהוָ֔ה מֵחֲדֹ֖ל לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעַדְכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה וְהַיְשָׁרָֽה׃

1 Samuel · 12:23

World English Bible

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13

If humanity's God is one, it makes little sense for each prophet to command a religion different at its core. The second verse names Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus and Muhammad under one command: establish the religion and do not divide in it. The first verses describe that way: upright, the way of Abraham, a life and death for God, and then the word Islam in its plain sense, surrender to Him. This is the religion all messengers were commanded, and each community was given its own way (5:48).

A question for you

What joins these messengers in the verses?

If you sayOne command.
ThenThen the question that follows is how the roads multiplied after them. The next part turns to that.
If you sayTheir people and their time.
ThenEach had his own people and time, and the verse names what joins them through it all.
If you sayI do not see what joins them.
ThenTest it yourself. A Step sets the words of Jesus beside this claim.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَأَنَّ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:153

Translation

Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

Original · Hebrew

מִ֤י חָכָם֙ וְיָ֣בֵֽן אֵ֔לֶּה נָב֖וֹן וְיֵֽדָעֵ֑ם כִּֽי־יְשָׁרִ֞ים דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְצַדִּקִים֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔ם וּפֹשְׁעִ֖ים יִכָּ֥שְׁלוּ בָֽם׃

Hosea · 14:9

World English Bible

﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110

Translation

When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him. But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

Original · Ancient Greek

ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν τὸν Πέτρον, συναντήσας αὐτῷ ὁ Κορνήλιος πεσὼν ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας προσεκύνησεν. ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν λέγων· Ἀνάστηθι· καὶ ἐγὼ αὐτὸς ἄνθρωπός εἰμι.

Acts · 10:25-26

World English Bible

A straight path is single by definition: between two points runs one straight line and many crooked ones. The first verse says there are side roads that scatter people from the way, so the Quran expects the roads to multiply. The second sums up what remains: whoever hopes to meet their Lord, let them do good, and give no one a share in His worship. Faith and deed in one sentence.

A question for you

What does 18:110 ask of a person?

If you sayGood deeds and undivided worship.
ThenBoth together. It remains for you to say what each means in your day.
If you sayBelonging to a particular group.
ThenNotice that the verse names no group. So what place does a community have on this path?
If you sayI want to know what to do now.
ThenThere is a question just for that, here when you want it.

The same in the other books
